# systeam_escalation_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing escalation policy by name within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the escalation policy to look up.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the escalation policy belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the escalation policy.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the escalation policy is active.
- `team_id` (Number) The team the escalation policy belongs to.
